channels.title: Chrome — desktop
channels.notes: Chrome desktop extension. Requires original enrolled native Device Bridge host.

channels.title: Edge — desktop
channels.notes: Edge extension. Requires the approved native Bridge host and published Edge ID.

channels.title: Firefox — desktop / supported Android
channels.notes: Firefox compatibility and native-messaging capabilities require platform-specific testing; Android does not imply desktop host access.

channels.title: Safari — Apple
channels.notes: Safari extension requires the original signed Apple containing app and Apple approval.

channels.title: LeeWay Android companion
channels.notes: The Android companion carries Device Bridge capabilities; Chrome on Android cannot install desktop Chrome extensions.

channels.title: LeeWay Apple companion
channels.notes: The Apple companion and Safari integration require approved native build and device enrollment.
